title: Core evidence on WBCAtt and Acevedo

caption: Core evidence on WBCAtt and Acevedo. Values are reported mean ± sample standard deviation over seeds 17, 29, and 43. N/A denotes an unsupported method-output contract, not zero. Best and second-best available results in each metric column are bolded and underlined, respectively; ties share the same marker. The proposed method is shaded. C1 is mixed; C3 has directional support but remains mixed because registered margins and harm balance are unfavorable.
